steps.label: helpers
steps.eval: (() => { window.__w = async (fn, ms = 30000) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; while (Date.now() < end) { try { const v = await fn(); if (v) return v; } catch (e) {} await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); } return 'TIMEOUT'; }; window.__open = (name) => { const pt = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dock-tab')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Project'); if (pt && !pt.classList.contains('active')) pt.click(); const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tree-row')].find(e => e.querySelector('.tree-name')?.textContent === name); if (!r) return false; r.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', {bubbles: true})); return true; }; window.__palette = async (text) => { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'a', code: 'KeyA', metaKey: true, shiftKey: true, bubbles: true})); const i = await __w(() => document.querySelector('.palette input, .pal-input, input.palette-input')); i.value = text; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Enter', bubbles: true})); return true; }; window.__view = () => { const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content')].find(t => !t.hidden && t.offsetParent)?.querySelector('.cm-content'); return c?.cmTile?.root?.view; }; window.__text = () => __view()?.state.doc.toString(); window.__tab = () => document.querySelector('.pane-active .tab.active, .tab.active')?.textContent || ''; window.__openWait = async (name) => { await __w(() => __open(name)); return __w(() => __tab().includes(name) && __view() && name); }; window.__key = (key, mods = {}) => { const c = __view().contentDOM; c.focus(); c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key, code: 'Key' + key.toUpperCase(), bubbles: true, cancelable: true, ...mods})); }; window.__status = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.status-item, [data-status-id], .statusbar *')].map(e => e.textContent).find(t => t && t.startsWith('Not formatted')) || ''; return true; })()

steps.label: AC5 Reformat File pretty-prints JSON, big int kept

steps.eval: (async () => { const before = __text(); await __palette('Reformat File'); return __w(() => { const t = __text(); return t !== before && ['// editor settings', '// trailing note', '/* block */', '// after list'].every(c => t.includes(c)) && t; }); })()
